name: Siglent Technologies Co. Ltd.
summary: Established in 2002 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, Siglent Technologies Co. Ltd. is a global enterprise focused on the entire lifecycle of electronic test and measurement equipment, from its conception, engineering, and production to its sale and maintenance. The company provides a broad portfolio of general-purpose testing instruments, including sophisticated digital oscilloscopes, arbitrary waveform generators, spectrum and network analyzers, and RF generators, alongside essential tools such as digital multimeters, DC power supplies, isolated handheld oscilloscopes, and DC electronic loads. Siglent serves a diverse range of industries, notably communications systems, automotive electronics, semiconductor manufacturing, and various segments of the broader electronics market.
